verdict.rationale: Bolna's Agent Studio is a built-in AI feature: the user hands it a short use-case description and it builds a call-ready voice agent, so one task can be delegated inside the product. It is a single-purpose builder, not a general in-product assistant. The MCP server connects external assistants, so it does not count here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant that takes arbitrary tasks (e.g. managing calls, batches, analytics), evidence of conversational or iterative delegation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Agent Studio.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Agent Studio turns a short description of your use case into a production-grade, call-ready voice AI agent — in 5 to 8 minutes. No prompt engineering, no guesswork.
